meta.title: Better Sidebar updater
meta.description: Check official GitHub versions, install the npm package and restart to apply.

title: Version updates
description: Check official GitHub releases and install the matching npm package. Settings are retained; restart to use the update.
restartManually: Save your work, then close and reopen the application to apply the update.
status_package-pending: The release is available; its installation package is not ready yet
status_incompatible: This version requires a newer application or runtime
status_error: Update failed. Your current installation is retained; check the connection and retry
settingsPageIntro: Manage content, file previews and opening behavior
settingsFeatureHint: Adjust this feature's options. Changes are saved automatically.
settingsCatalogHint: Find an extension, copy its install command, and run it in the terminal where DSH is installed.
settingsAgent: Allow the model to open the sidebar
settingsAgentHint: The model can use sidebar_open to open files, folders and web pages
settingsCssHint: Applied immediately after saving. Saved styles are retained during official updates.
settingsDraftFailed: Could not apply. Your draft is retained.
settingsSaveFailed: Settings could not be saved. Try again.
settingsDesc_git: Review Git status and file operations in this turn
settingsDesc_diff: Compare file contents before and after changes
settingsDesc_editor: Browse folders, open and edit files
settingsDesc_terminal-bottom: Run terminal commands in the bottom workbench
settingsDesc_sidechat: Have a separate conversation in the sidebar
